title: CF-VLA: Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2604.24622v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer strong expressivity for action generation, but suffer from a fundamental inefficiency: multi-step inference is required to recover action structure from uninformative Gaussian noise, leading to a poor efficiency-quality trade-off under real-time constraints. We address this issue by rethinking the role of the starting point in generative action modeling. Instead of shortening the sampling trajectory, we propose CF-VLA, a coarse-to-fine two-stage formulation that restructures action generation into a coarse initialization step that constructs an action-aware starting point, followed by a single-step local refinement that corrects residual errors. Concretely, the coarse stage learns a conditional posterior over endpoint velocity to transform Gaussian noise into a structured initialization, while the fine stage performs a fixed-time refinement from this initialization. translated_title: CF-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的高效由粗到细动作生成方法
translated_abstract: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为动作生成提供了强大的表达能力，但存在一个根本性的效率问题：需要多步推理才能从无信息的高斯噪声中恢复动作结构，导致在实时约束下的效率与质量难以兼顾。我们通过重新思考生成式动作建模中起点的角色来解决这一问题。我们没有选择缩短采样轨迹，而是提出了 CF-VLA，一种由粗到细的两阶段方法，将动作生成重构为：先通过一个粗略初始化步骤构建具有动作感知能力的起点，随后进行单步局部细化以纠正残余误差。具体而言，粗阶段学习一个关于末端速度的条件后验分布，将高斯噪声转化为结构化的初始化，而细阶段则从该初始化出发进行固定时间的细化。为了稳……
tldr: CF-VLA 提出由粗到细的两阶段动作生成框架，先构建动作感知的粗略初始化起点，再通过单步局部细化纠正误差，从而显著改善视觉-语言-动作策略在实时约束下的效率与质量权衡。
en_tdlr: CF-VLA proposes a coarse-to-fine two-stage action generation framework that first constructs an action-aware coarse initialization and then performs single-step local refinement, significantly improving the efficiency-quality trade-off of vision-language-action policies under real-time constraints.
